oracle.activityBoundary: every callActivity argument and return value crosses oracle/lib/boundary.js, as the Durable Task extension serialises them; OutboundInformantRegister therefore receives the ORCHESTRATOR's hearing, not the copy SetInformantRegister mutated

contract.basis: cpp-platform-core-domain/criminal-court-public-model/src/main/resources/json/schema/global/prosecutionCaseIdentifier.json types majorCreditorCode as "string" with no pattern or enum; all three values are legal
contract.note: Parity obligation: the Java port must reproduce this.

provenance.note: Court application only (DERPF), one hearing day, populated courtCentre with lja.
provenance.operatorDescription: Sets majorCreditorCode on every prosecuting authority to a code that exists in the subscription input.
provenance.operatorRationale: majorCreditorCode is the ONLY thing that makes a subscription match: SetInformantRegister/index.js:47,88 copies it onto the fragment, InformantRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:47 assigns it to SubscriptionObject.ouCode, and SubscriptionsService.js:49 compares it to subscription.informantCode. Twelve of the thirteen real hearing fixtures carry no majorCreditorCode at all, so without this operator the entire recipient/subscription half of the document is never exercised.

operatorDetail.why: a code held by more than one subscription — RecipientMapper.js:13 emits one recipient per matching subscription
